description:
`LRUCache` evicts entries that were just read.

With `LRUCache(maxsize=3)`: insert `a`, `b`, `c`, read `cache["a"]`, then insert `d`. The cache evicts `a` — the key that was accessed a moment ago — and keeps `b`, which has not been touched since it was inserted. The same happens when the read goes through `cache.get("a")`.

Eviction order seems to depend only on insertion order, so the cache behaves like a FIFO queue instead of a least-recently-used cache. Reading an entry should count as using it.
bug_patch:
diff --git a/src/cachetools/__init__.py b/src/cachetools/__init__.py
index e992f5c..9923ef8 100644
--- a/src/cachetools/__init__.py
+++ b/src/cachetools/__init__.py
@@ -292,10 +292,7 @@ class LRUCache(Cache):
         self.__order = collections.OrderedDict()
 
     def __getitem__(self, key, cache_getitem=Cache.__getitem__):
-        value = cache_getitem(self, key)
-        if key in self:  # __missing__ may not store item
-            self.__touch(key)
-        return value
+        return cache_getitem(self, key)
 
     def __setitem__(self, key, value, cache_setitem=Cache.__setitem__):
         cache_setitem(self, key, value)
gold_patch:
diff --git a/src/cachetools/__init__.py b/src/cachetools/__init__.py
index 9923ef8..e992f5c 100644
--- a/src/cachetools/__init__.py
+++ b/src/cachetools/__init__.py
@@ -292,7 +292,10 @@ class LRUCache(Cache):
         self.__order = collections.OrderedDict()
 
     def __getitem__(self, key, cache_getitem=Cache.__getitem__):
-        return cache_getitem(self, key)
+        value = cache_getitem(self, key)
+        if key in self:  # __missing__ may not store item
+            self.__touch(key)
+        return value
 
     def __setitem__(self, key, value, cache_setitem=Cache.__setitem__):
         cache_setitem(self, key, value)
hidden_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_repopilot_cachetools_003.py b/tests/test_repopilot_cachetools_003.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..40b80f1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_repopilot_cachetools_003.py
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+from cachetools import LRUCache
+
+
+def test_reading_a_key_protects_it_from_eviction():
+    cache = LRUCache(maxsize=3)
+    cache["a"] = 1
+    cache["b"] = 2
+    cache["c"] = 3
+    assert cache["a"] == 1  # "a" is now the most recently used entry
+    cache["d"] = 4  # must evict the least recently used entry: "b"
+    assert "a" in cache
+    assert "b" not in cache
+    assert sorted(cache) == ["a", "c", "d"]
+
+
+def test_get_counts_as_a_use():
+    cache = LRUCache(maxsize=2)
+    cache["x"] = 1
+    cache["y"] = 2
+    assert cache.get("x") == 1
+    cache["z"] = 3
+    assert "x" in cache
+    assert "y" not in cache
